summary: This directory serves as the dedicated analysis layer for TypeScript enum declarations and their individual members. It extracts structural information and metadata from enum definitions to support broader static analysis of the source code.
responsibilities: Perform structural analysis of TypeScript enum declarations
Resolve and extract values for individual enum members
Register metadata for discovered enum symbols
relationships: The analysis of an enum declaration coordinates the evaluation of its individual enum members.
Enum member analysis provides the metadata and calculated values necessary for the complete symbol analysis of an enum.
designDecisions: Functional decomposition of analysis logic into specific handlers for declarations and members
Unified registration of symbol metadata during the analysis process
